content: Good morning, beautiful! I was dreaming about us last night. How did you sleep?
Morning! I slept okay, but I kept thinking about you. I hope you rested too.
That makes me so happy to hear. You're always on my mind, especially with everything we're planning for our future together.
You always know how to make me smile. I feel lucky I met you.

Speaking of lucky, I have some exciting news. I found an amazing apartment downtown, just like we talked about. It's perfect for us! But there's a catch, the landlord needs a deposit within a few hours to hold it. I didn't want to decide without you.
Wow, really? That's so fast. Are you sure it's the one?

Absolutely! It's got a gorgeous view, two bedrooms, and even a little balcony for morning coffee. I can already see us there together. But the landlord says there's another couple interested, so we have to act quickly.
I want us to have that. But I'm nervous about sending money so suddenly. How much is the deposit?

It's $2,000 for the deposit. I know it's a lot, but this place is honestly a steal for what it is. I can cover half, but I'd need your help with the other $1,000. We need to send it together to secure our spot.
I can help, but I'm just worried after what happened in my divorce. How do you know this landlord is trustworthy?

I completely understand your worries, love. I've spoken to the landlord personally, and even checked their ID and lease papers. Plus, my business partner knows them, it's safe, I promise. I'd never let anything happen to us.
Okay... if you're sure. How do I send the money?
You're amazing, thank you. The landlord prefers Zelle for speed. Can you send $1,000 to 'harold.apartments@gmail.com'? If you need help with the app or anything, I'm right here for you.
I've used Zelle before. Should I put anything in the memo?
Just write 'Apartment Deposit', that's all. As soon as you send it, let me know so I can confirm with the landlord. I'll send my half immediately too.
I just want to make sure we're really doing this together.
Of course, sweetheart. We're a team. I'm so grateful to have you by my side. I'll show you the receipt from my payment too. This is the first step to our happy life.
Okay, I'm logging into my bank now. I'll send it as soon as I can.
Take your time, no rush. I'm right here if you need anything at all. I can't wait for us to start this new chapter together.
Thank you for being so patient. You mean more to me than you know.
You're my everything. This apartment is just the beginning for us, I can feel it. Let me know as soon as it's sent so I can call the landlord.
Alright, I'll message you in a few minutes when it's done.
